reels.title: Mazaq Day 2 real (study mood)
storyboard: Late-night study/work scene with the person focused on the laptop and Mazaq beside them.
The person continues studying while the voice-over says: “وراكم مذاكرة كتير؟”
A subtle camera movement reveals the Mazaq coffee, connecting it naturally to the study moment.
reels.whyItWorks: The reel uses a relatable study moment and a simple voice-over to position Mazaq as a small boost that makes long study days feel better. The product is integrated naturally into the scene rather than feeling like a hard sell.
